svg.title: Rust execution and Arrow exchange
svg.desc: Rust operators in Polars, DataFusion, and Daft avoid a tracing garbage collector and safe Rust checks many data races. Separately, Arrow-compatible paths in those engines and Ray Data can exchange columnar buffers. Compatible buffers may be reused, but copies and Python runtime overhead remain possible.
